title: National ID services
guidance: The Bangladesh Election Commission's NID Wing lists online NID services, smart card status, amendments, and duplicate NID information. Open the official site for the current service instructions.
notes: General service pointer only; does not state requirements or fees.

title: Birth registration services
guidance: The government BDRIS portal provides the birth registration application. Check the official form for the current options and instructions.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: E-passport services
guidance: The official e-Passport portal offers online applications and re-issues, application instructions, and a link to current fees. Check it before applying.

title: Online tax services
guidance: The National Board of Revenue e-Tax portal links to e-TIN registration, e-Return filing, return verification, and tax payment services.

title: Online general diary
guidance: Bangladesh Police provides an Online GD service for submitting a complaint and checking its status. Follow the instructions on the official portal.
notes: General service pointer only; emergencies require the appropriate emergency channel.

title: Driving licence services
guidance: The BRTA Service Portal supports learner licences, driving licences, renewals, and duplicate licences. Register or sign in there for current service options.

title: Birth registration application
guidance: The BDRIS application asks you to select a registration location and enter the registered person's, parents', and address information. Review the official form before submission.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration
notes: The form itself lists supporting information and upload requirements.

title: Learner driving licence
guidance: BRTA says a learner licence is the first step toward a driving licence. The BRTA Service Portal is the place to apply and review current instructions.
notes: Check BRTA for updated eligibility, documents, and fees.

title: Apply for a duplicate NID
guidance: The Election Commission's NID Wing lists duplicate NID issuance and links to NID Online Services. Use its official site for the latest application route.
notes: No fee or document requirements are stated here.

title: Apply for birth registration online
guidance: Open the official BDRIS birth registration application, choose the appropriate registration location, and complete the form using the information it requests.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration
notes: The portal shows the current form and submission requirements.

title: Apply for an e-passport online
guidance: The e-Passport portal provides an online application for a new passport or re-issue. Read its instructions and check regional availability before starting.
notes: Application requirements vary; use the official instructions.

title: File a tax return online
guidance: The National Board of Revenue e-Tax portal provides the e-Return service for online tax return filing. Use the official portal for the current filing workflow.
notes: No deadline or filing obligation is stated here.

title: Submit an online GD
guidance: The Bangladesh Police Online GD portal explains how to register, enter incident details, submit a complaint, and check its status. Follow the current instructions on that site.
notes: This does not replace emergency assistance.

title: Apply for a learner licence
guidance: BRTA describes the learner licence as the first step. Apply through the BRTA Service Portal and check its current requirements before submitting.
notes: Check BRTA for updated eligibility, documents, and fees.
